## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one cohesive responsibility and respects core ownership.
- [ ] Core remains free of HTTP, MCP, gateway, process, filesystem, and concrete-host behavior.
- [ ] Files and functions stay within budgets or use a reviewed exact-path exception.
- [ ] Public contracts have requirements, deterministic tests, and compatibility notes.
- [ ] No copied implementation source, proprietary file, save, credential, or build output is included.
- [ ] Remaining risks and runtime-unverified claims are explicit.
